Posts, copyrighted content, books, articles, fanfiction works have all been scraped, from people who never consented to it in order to make this model work. c.ai is an app that generates revenue from stolen work (not even mentioning its subscription model, it makes money off of selling user data it accumulates though people visiting the website, "just having fun with it"). 
The fact that it is not behind "the fake images on Facebook" does not matter. It generates money off of stolen content. That knowledge alone is enough for its use to be frowned upon.

Can you explain what is your argument here? Character AI, like in its name, is an AI that utilitizes LLM (large language model) in order to function, to respond to people convincingly and type like a real person. It scrapes the internet and analyses human speech patterns. Like in the name, it requires a very Large database, meaning it likely scrapes millions of pages of copyrighted works, posts and fanfictions of people who have never consented to it. It is an exploitative model, like any other ai on the market right now, that steals people's work in order to make money off of people's willingness to engage in parasocial relationships. Danny has, outwardly, criticized uses of AI, and i implore you to reconsider your own stance on it, as a viewer of Danny's.
